FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A15
The 180-day window before expiration is for early renewal, while the 60-day window after expiration is a grace period in which the license is still valid. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint renewal-timing; prereq_hint sec02-F17; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F17, sec02-F19.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A15
Renewing without an exam is allowed up to 3 years after expiration, but that late-renewal window does not let you drive on the expired license. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint renewal-timing; prereq_hint sec02-F19; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F20, sec02-F21, sec02-R01.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A15
A normal renewal runs four years from issue, whereas a late renewal runs four years from the last expiration date. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint renewal-timing; prereq_hint sec02-F20; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F17, sec02-F20.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A15
A duplicate replaces an unexpired license that is lost, destroyed or unreadable, while a renewal replaces one that is expiring or expired. [A15]
Why it matters: group_hint license-upkeep; prereq_hint sec02-F17; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F22, sec02-F17.
Source: [A15 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0015]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A16
An address change within Alabama must be reported within 30 days and is free, while a corrected license after a name change carries a duplicate fee. [A16]
Why it matters: group_hint license-upkeep; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F25, sec02-F26.
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A13
The knowledge test leads to the learner license, while the road test is the final step that leads to the regular license. [A13]
Why it matters: group_hint test-sequence; prereq_hint sec02-F04; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec02-F05, sec02-F08.
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A13
Corrective lenses are required during the road test for drivers already restricted to them, and are required for all driving when the vision exam finds they are needed. [A13]
Why it matters: group_hint vision; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F01, sec02-F02.
Source: [A13 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0013]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A16
Class D is the ordinary passenger-vehicle license, while Class M is for motorcycles and motor-driven cycles and Class V for motorized watercraft. [A16]
Why it matters: group_hint license-classes; prereq_hint none; difficulty_hint 1; confusable_with sec02-F27.
Source: [A16 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0016]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A17
Class A and Class B both involve vehicles rated over 26,000 pounds, but Class A applies when the towed vehicle is rated over 10,000 pounds and Class B when the tow is no more than that. [A17]
Why it matters: group_hint license-classes; prereq_hint sec02-F27; difficulty_hint 3; confusable_with sec02-F28, sec02-F29.
Source: [A17 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0017]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A18
A second hands-free conviction within 24 months doubles the first fine to $100 with 2 points, and a third brings $150 with 3 points. [A18]
Why it matters: group_hint hands-free; prereq_hint sec02-F34; difficulty_hint 2; confusable_with sec02-F35.
Source: [A18 -> src:rdmv-al-d:alabama-law-enforcement-agency-alea-driv:handbook:pdf-0018]
